name: 研发工时表(明细)
query:
SELECT e.name AS "员工ID:Data:1",
       e.employee_name AS "员工:Data:140",
       tsd.project AS "项目:Data:160",
       SUM(tsd.hours) AS "工时:Float:90"
FROM `tabEmployee` e
JOIN `tabTimesheet` ts ON ts.employee=e.name AND ts.docstatus=1
JOIN `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd ON tsd.parent=ts.name AND DATE_FORMAT(tsd.from_time,'%%Y-%%m')=%(period)s
JOIN `tabProject` p ON p.name=tsd.project AND COALESCE(p.allow_rd_timesheet,0)=1
WHERE e.rd_personnel_type IN ('全时研发','非全时研发','研发辅助')
GROUP BY e.name, tsd.project
ORDER BY e.employee_name, tsd.project

name: 研发人员台账
query:
SELECT e.name AS "工号:Data:110", e.employee_name AS "姓名:Data:120",
       e.rd_personnel_type AS "研发人员类型:Data:120",
       COUNT(DISTINCT tsd.project) AS "参与项目数:Int:100",
       COALESCE(SUM(tsd.hours),0) AS "本期工时:Float:100"
FROM `tabEmployee` e
LEFT JOIN `tabTimesheet` ts ON ts.employee = e.name AND ts.docstatus = 1
LEFT JOIN `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd ON tsd.parent = ts.name AND DATE_FORMAT(tsd.from_time,'%%Y-%%m')=%(period)s AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabProject` p WHERE p.name=tsd.project AND COALESCE(p.allow_rd_timesheet,0)=1)
WHERE e.rd_personnel_type IN ('全时研发','非全时研发','研发辅助') AND e.date_of_joining <= LAST_DAY(CONCAT(%(period)s,'-01')) AND (e.relieving_date IS NULL OR e.relieving_date >= CONCAT(%(period)s,'-01'))
GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY 5 DESC
